verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own Integration Server API, with generated partner credentials (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret), an OAuth2 authorization code flow for short-lived per-user access tokens, and client secret rotation. The pack does not show which data the API exposes, so the transaction, expense, and receipt pull capability is unproven. Missing for 10: documented endpoints for pulling transactions, expenses, and receipts; scoped token permissions; confirmation that the API is REST-style; independent or hands-on corroboration.
